title: PIT test agrees with its verifier
statement: For all bit strings $x$ and $r$, applying the PIT test to the encoded pair of $x$ and $r$ returns the same Boolean value as the verifier applied to $x$ and $r$.
caveat: The definitions of the PIT test and verifier are supplied only as formal constructions, so their computational meaning cannot be fully described in a short standalone statement.
